title: What if you ran a river through your garden?

sections.label: Hook
sections.text: You live forty metres from a river. So you do the obvious thing.
sections.speaker_directions: Calm, curious, slightly deadpan second-person narrator; quickens from s7 onward.

sections.label: Dig
sections.text: You dig a channel right through your back garden, all the way to your patio.
sections.speaker_directions: Calm, curious, slightly deadpan second-person narrator; quickens from s7 onward.

sections.label: Let it in
sections.text: Then you knock out the last wall of dirt, and let the river in.
sections.speaker_directions: Calm, curious, slightly deadpan second-person narrator; quickens from s7 onward.

sections.label: Paradise
sections.text: And it's perfect. A stream, a pond, a water wheel turning by your back door. Fresh water, all year round, for free.
sections.speaker_directions: Calm, curious, slightly deadpan second-person narrator; quickens from s7 onward.

sections.label: Erosion
sections.text: But moving water never stops working. Every second it carries a little of your soil away. The bends get wider, the banks cave in.
sections.speaker_directions: Calm, curious, slightly deadpan second-person narrator; quickens from s7 onward.

sections.label: Armour
sections.text: So you fight back. Tonnes of granite along every bank.
sections.speaker_directions: Calm, curious, slightly deadpan second-person narrator; quickens from s7 onward.

sections.label: Rise
sections.text: And it holds. Until spring. Snow melts upstream, and overnight the river rises two metres.
sections.speaker_directions: Calm, curious, slightly deadpan second-person narrator; quickens from s7 onward.

sections.label: Torrent
sections.text: And you just built it the easiest path in the valley. Now the whole river wants your garden.
sections.speaker_directions: Calm, curious, slightly deadpan second-person narrator; quickens from s7 onward.

sections.label: Inside
sections.text: It pours over the rocks, across the lawn, and straight through your back door.
sections.speaker_directions: Calm, curious, slightly deadpan second-person narrator; quickens from s7 onward.

sections.label: Street
sections.text: And since your garden opens onto the street, it doesn't stop at your house.
sections.speaker_directions: Calm, curious, slightly deadpan second-person narrator; quickens from s7 onward.

sections.label: Payoff
sections.text: Turns out you didn't borrow a river. You moved it.
sections.speaker_directions: Calm, curious, slightly deadpan second-person narrator; quickens from s7 onward.
